$comment: The attachments of a received email, each WITH its signed download URL -- where email_get lists only their metadata. Read from https://resend.com/docs/api-reference/emails/list-received-email-attachments, checked 2026-09-15. `after` and `before` are Resend's cursors and cannot be combined; the vocabulary has no word for "not both", so the descriptions say it and Resend refuses it.
title: List attachments
description: List a received email's attachments, each with a signed download URL.

config.label: Email ID
config.description: The received email's id -- `data.email_id` on the delivery, or `email.id` after the trigger's read.

config.label: Page size
config.description: Attachments per page, 1 to 100. Leave blank for all of them.

config.label: After
config.description: An attachment id: the page after it. Not together with `before`.

config.label: Before
config.description: An attachment id: the page before it. Not together with `after`.

outputShape.description: Which estate this ran against. Resend has no sandbox, so: fake or live.
The connection id that was used.
Whether another page exists beyond this one.
The attachments on this page: id, filename, size, content_type, content_disposition, content_id, download_url, expires_at. Resend's own envelope, so the list is at data.data.
